title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Ben James Leads Canadian Open
items.text: Ben James finished the second round at 10-under to lead the RBC Canadian Open by one shot over Sam Burns, Jackson Suber, and Haotong Li, securing a signature PGA TOUR title opportunity.

items.headline: Scheffler Targets Career Slam
items.text: World number one Scottie Scheffler aims to become the seventh golfer to complete the career Grand Slam by winning the 126th US Open starting Thursday at Shinnecock Hills.

items.headline: Canadian Open Round 3 Tee Times
items.text: Ben James tees off at 1:45 p.m. Saturday as the 2026 RBC Canadian Open enters Round 3 at TPC Toronto with key players like Sam Burns and Brooks Koepka also in action.
